note: Nothing came across byte-for-byte. Unlike the earlier ports, whose captured model and loader were self-contained step-1 files, this method's captured code interleaves step 1 (AlexNet) and step 2 (ViT) in single files (train.py 1161 lines, utils.py 812 lines, models/context_encoder.py, datasets.py, evaluate_linear.py), so extracting a clean step-1 port required rewriting each. captured_sha256 is therefore empty; every file's captured digest is recorded below so a reviewer can diff against the capture. Step 2 (the ViT variant and its two-optimiser / bfloat16 / always-adversarial STEP2 protocol, and the 812-line utils.py that holds it) was not brought across (the contract's stages are step1 and linear_eval); dropping the ViT also dropped the timm dependency it needed.
